resources.string: Qubee needs access to your camera, microphone, and network so peer-to-peer messaging and calls can work end-to-end on your device.
Without these permissions Qubee cannot deliver or receive messages. Open Settings to enable them, or exit.
Incoming chat messages from your peers.
Keeps the peer-to-peer node running while the app is in the background.
Authentication is unavailable. Restore device authentication and try again.
Unlock did not return a usable key. Try again.
Couldn\'t decrypt the local database key. Try again.
Verify with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to open your conversations.
Ask for your fingerprint, face, or device PIN when Qubee opens or returns from the background. Gates the app UI; it does not yet encrypt the database under your unlock.
Qubee has no servers. Another device can reach you only if it finds this one, either on the same Wi-Fi or through an address you hand it.
Announces this device and its local IP to everyone on the network (mDNS) and connects to the Qubee devices it hears. Off by default.
Addresses copied from the other device\'s \"This device\" list, one per line. Qubee dials them at start and keeps retrying while disconnected.
No addresses yet: the node is still starting, or this device has no network.
